sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface labeling with α-bungarotoxin conjugates confirmed cell-surface display of the full-length tagged channel; electrophysiological function of the BBS-tagged KV10.1 was not explicitly reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: L1–L5 collectively document a tolerated BBS insertion at position 318 of KV10.1 (KCNH1), which lies in the second extracellular loop (S5-S6 linker) of that channel. KCNH5 (hEag2/KV10.2) is the closest paralog of KCNH1 within the EAG subfamily and shares the same 6-TM topology; its second extracellular loop spans residues 368–446 (79 aa), providing ample space for a ~27-aa insert. Because the cited residue (318) is in KV10.1 numbering and no KCNH5-specific residue is named in any ledger line, the exact junction within the KCNH5 loop cannot be pinned without alignment, so insert_after_residue is left null and the site is classified as inferred. The EC1 loop (237–245, only 9 residues) was considered but is too short to accommodate a 13–23 aa tag and has no ledger support. A 27-residue α-bungarotoxin-binding site (BBS; core 13 aa WRYYESSLEPYPD plus GS linkers) was inserted at aa 318 of KV10.1 (KCNH1/EAG1), a close EAG-subfamily paralog of KCNH5 (KV10.2/EAG2). The insertion was placed in the second extracellular loop (S5-S6 linker) of the full-length, membrane-anchored channel, mimicking the site of a naturally occurring 27-aa splice-variant insert. The tagged channel was expressed in mammalian cells and confirmed to reach the cell surface by α-bungarotoxin-conjugate binding.

sources.claim: The α-bungarotoxin-binding site (BBS) was inserted into K V 10.1 at aa position 318.

literature_notes: L6 and L7 describe full-length hEag2 (KCNH5) with a C-terminal EGFP+FLAG fusion expressed in HEK293T cells, with electrophysiological confirmation of voltage-activated delayed-rectifier function. However, the KCNH5 C-terminus falls entirely within the intracellular domain (residues 465–988 per the authoritative topology landmarks); this tag is therefore not an extracellular surface tag and is recorded in other_positions. The EC1 loop (237–245, 9 residues) is the only other extracellular span but is too short for a ~15–23 aa insert and has no ledger support. L1–L5 all concern KV10.1 (KCNH1), a close EAG-subfamily paralog; they qualify as indirect evidence for the homologous second extracellular loop of KCNH5 but do not name a KCNH5 residue, so the site is inferred and ranked low confidence.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length hEag2 (KCNH5) was expressed with a C-terminal EGFP+FLAG tag and confirmed functional by patch-clamp, but the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (residues 465–988) and is not accessible on the extracellular face.
